description: Favourable efficient pump vs an uncoupled pump (near-zero coupling efficiency), every other parameter held equal, over a declining external gradient. Isolates that the internalization / autonomy benefit requires COUPLING, not the carrier's mere presence.
verdict: uncoupled pump collapses (cannot internalize) → the benefit requires coupling
note_is_empty: catalyst_efficiency=0.0 is backfilled to the default (1.0) by the pbg is_empty(0.0) rule, so the uncoupled control uses eff=1e-6; a bare 0.0 would silently reproduce the favourable arm.
note_first_law: The formal first-law / free-energy ledger closure (in + E0 - work - dissipated = E(t), residual ~1e-16) is demonstrated by the proto-energetics arm's FreeEnergyLedgerProcess; here free_energy_flux is the internalized-power readout that collapses with the pump uncoupled.
